appDescription: A personal in-car AI that understands the driver's own way of speaking: it corrects misheard place names using the driver's on-device visit history, asks with up to three choices on the head-up display only when unsure, and also plans EV charging stops and keeps the parked cabin safe for pets.

function.name: GO_TO_MY_PLACE
function.description: Navigate to a place the driver mentions, even if the name was misheard or vague (for example 'the usual bakery'). The app matches it against the driver's own on-device visit history and asks with up to three choices on the head-up display when unsure.

place.description: The place name or description exactly as heard from the driver.

stop_type.description: Whether to go there now or stop by on the current route.

function.name: PLAN_EV_TRIP
function.description: Plan a trip to a destination that combines EV charging stops and passenger rest breaks based on the current battery level.

companions.description: Who is travelling with the driver.

function.name: START_CARE_MODE
function.description: Keep the parked cabin at a comfortable temperature for a pet left inside or for a short rest, and show a status screen.
